[FI] Discovering the gazes from the sliding door, we 
stiffened.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] J-Just what are you two doing there...

[FI] Kuroneko threw the cushion that was next to her. 
The two of them let out a tiny scream and jumped 
aside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] If you do as I say, I'll add an extra side-dish for 
dinner.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Okay Tama-chan! Play with sis outside!

[FI] With the final order from the chief of the kitchen, 
the two swiftly headed out.

[FI] Judging from their behavior, I don't think they'll be 
back anytime soon. Suddenly, Kuroneko buried her 
face in my chest.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Can we... stay like this for a while...

[FI] Probably feeling relieved after my response, she 
silently closed her eyes.

[FI] And we stayed like that, sharing each other's 
warmth.
